w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 5 raiders (The Eater, The Loud Beast, The Redactor, The Reunion, The Redactor) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: Back at the haven the argument starts: Wanda is calling it "Old Gavel." Nobody agrees yet — weigh in if you want.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Focus Group.

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: You catch Feng telling the fire about Sam. "Sam came back mauled by Spool (7 rounds, 44 taken) and alive. A missing tip of the left ear now." The story's already growing.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Chorus Line is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w5Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Cancellation is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w5Mentions.name: The Timeslot
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Timeslot.
firstContext: 💛 You hold Notebook. Route optimizations, glitch lists, apocalypse patch notes. 'DO NOT TRUST THE CACHE BY THE RIVER.' Your magnum opus, half-finished. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they have carried you this far. The feast was the weapon.
Travel 1 tile to grove.
Something moves out there — The Timeslot.
👁️ Feng freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
💬 Sam: "Smell that? Something's different here."

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🔥 The fire settles. Aurora has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Focus Group — I put it down today." "The murmur rises — you can HEAR them deliberating. w5Mentions.name: The Commercial Break
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 7,4. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A full seat. global standing, every wave faced, the deeds complete. The table rises when you enter. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 5 · Forage 49 → 24 · capped · Craft 13 · Talk 15 · Explore 49 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Leo Martin ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
